config.design: Fixed task PCA128 plus frozen natural residual cluster-center spans (two seeds, rank8), random residual spans rank8, full residual, full donor and identity. All32eligible pairs bidirectional; no outcome selection or fitting. Centers from natural discovery only, not new task examples.
config.controls: Two independent random residual spans; paired +/- isotropic residual noise norm-matched to centers9981 projected edit. Random controls are not matched to unknown causal directions.
config.metrics: Signed donor-directed task-margin change; KL(full-donor-patched output || arm output), KL(arm || native), edit energy. Full donor reference stays in recipient context.
config.limits: Fixed MLP12; negative results do not rule out other sites. Projection is a donor-informed intervention, not a deployable task predictor or evidence for discrete semantic clusters. Cue confounds from H999 remain; factorial controls pending.
config.holdouts: Only noun_expectation and word_fragment. List_marker explicitly excluded. No reserved tests or training.
